reasons: The rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding Customer; the cited paragraphs (§14.8 Personnel, §14.16 Freedom of Action) contain no solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction, so classifying this as compliant rather than missing is correct under the playbook's semantics.

No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — importing non-solicit language would create a restriction on our party that the Vendor has not sought.

The failed deterministic checks (duration cap, general-solicitation carve-out) presuppose an existing non-solicit clause and are properly treated as non-probative here; they do not undermine the conclusion.
Rationale is accurate to the quoted text and appropriately notes this is retained as internal coverage evidence, not a negotiation issue.
